email.subject: Quick fix for CoastAir Pros' site
email.body:
Hi Ivy,

I looked at CoastAir Pros' website. Two things are likely costing you jobs: there's no way to book or request service online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next HVAC company. And the homepage title doesn't mention heating/cooling or Harbor Falls, which hurts how you show up in local search results.

I fix issues like this for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd change and why? No pressure either way.

Alex
